### 2026-10-07 – In this session I worked on the schematic for my Starbie. I learnt keyboard shortcuts for putting in wires, sensors, and more. At first, I didn't get how to assign footprints and which goes where, but

**1.08h**

In this session I worked on the schematic for my Starbie. I learnt keyboard shortcuts for putting in wires, sensors, and more. At first, I didn't get how to assign footprints and which goes where, but after looking at the guide more carefully it became clear.
